license_required.quote: A person shall not sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance in this State for any line, class, or classes of insurance unless the person is licensed for the proper line of authority or class in accordance with this article.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen years of age;

moral_character_required.quote: Has not committed any act that is a ground for a licensure sanction set forth in section 431:9A-112;

required.quote: A person applying for an insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner on the uniform application

exams.name: Insurance Producer License Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of lines of authority applied for, duties and responsibilities of an insurance producer, and insurance laws and rules of Hawaii. Exam scores valid for two years.
exams.jurisdiction: state (commissioner may contract with outside testing service)
exams.quote: An applicant for an insurance producer license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to section 431:9A-109.

required.quote: To qualify for a license renewal, a licensee shall: (1) Preceding a license renewal, complete the required number of credit hours as set forth in subsection (b) in approved continuing education courses

hours_per_period.quote: the requisite number of credit hours shall be twenty-four credit hours

value: 21 credit hours relating to the line of authority for which the license is held (single group)
3 credit hours relating to ethics training or insurance laws and rules
10 credit hours relating to life/accident and health or sickness (dual group)
11 credit hours relating to property/casualty lines (dual group)
topical_requirements.quote: the requisite number of credit hours shall be twenty-four credit hours, consisting of twenty-one credit hours relating to the line of authority for which the license is held and three credit hours relating to ethics training or relating to the insurance laws and the insurance rules

available.quote: a nonresident applicant shall receive a nonresident producer license if: (1) The applicant is currently licensed and is in good standing as a resident producer in the applicant's home state

requirements.value: Nonresident applicant must be currently licensed and in good standing in home state, submit proper request and fees, submit uniform application or home state application, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Hawaii residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: The commissioner shall waive any requirements for a nonresident license applicant with a valid license from the applicant's home state, except the requirements imposed by section 431:9A-108, so long as the applicant's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this State on the same basis.

definition_quote.value: "Insurance producer" or "producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this State to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance producer" or "producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this State to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" means to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurance company. "Solicit" means attempting to sell insurance or asking or urging a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular company. "Negotiate" means the act of conferring directly with or offering advice directly to a purchaser or prospective purchaser of a particular contract of insurance concerning any of the substantive benefits, terms, or conditions of the contract

value: Variable life and variable annuity products
Any other line of insurance permitted under state law or rule
lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive a license in one or more of the following lines of authority: (1) Life ... (2) Accident and health or sickness ... (3) Property ... (4) Casualty ... (5) Variable life and variable annuity products ... (6) Personal ... (7) Credit ... (8) Any other line of insurance permitted under state law or rule.

resident_license_available.quote: A person applying for an insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner on the uniform application

nonresident_license_available.quote: a nonresident applicant shall receive a nonresident producer license if: (1) The applicant is currently licensed and is in good standing as a resident producer in the applicant's home state

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer is required to obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated a licensed producer who is a natural person responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and rules of this State

temporary_license_available.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days without requiring an examination

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days without requiring an examination

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the producer becomes an appointed agent of that insurer.

appointment_fee.value: Fee set forth in article 7, paid by appointing insurer for each producer appointed
appointment_fee.quote: An appointing insurer shall pay an appointment fee, in the amount and method of payment set forth in article 7, for each producer appointed by the appointing insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or its authorized representative that terminates the appointment, employment, contract, or other insurance business relationship with a producer shall notify the commissioner within thirty days following the effective date of the termination

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: Every licensed producer shall have the responsibilities of a trustee for all premium and return premium funds received or collected under this article.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: A producer shall report to the commissioner any civil or administrative action taken against the producer in any jurisdiction or by a governmental agency in any state within thirty days of the final disposition of the matter.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The commissioner may verify the producer's licensing status through the producer database maintained by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners, its affiliates, or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this State shall make application within ninety days of establishing legal residence to become a resident licensee pursuant to section 431:9A-106.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An insurance producer who allows the producer's license to become inactive for nonpayment of the renewal fee may reinstate that license without the necessity of passing a written examination, if the fee payable and a penalty in the amount of double the then-unpaid renewal fees are paid within twelve months from the inactivation date

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: Has submitted a full set of fingerprints, including a scanned file from a hard copy fingerprint, for the commissioner to obtain and receive national and state criminal history record checks from the Federal Bureau of Investigation and the Hawaii criminal justice data center
